definition: [ פָּצַע ] verb bruise, wound by bruising (Late Hebrew split, bruise ; Arabic squeeze a ripe date, rub ; Aramaic פְּצַע split ); — Qal Perfect 3 plural suffix הִכּוּנִי פְּצָעוּנִי Song 5:7 Infinitive absolute הַכֵּה וּפָצֹעַ 1Kgs 20:37 a smiting and a bruising (him); Participle Pass. construct פְּצוּעַדַּֿכָּה Deut 23:2 one wounded by crushing.
